description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

The Enterprise Account Executive (ENT) is responsible for driving complex, high-value enterprise deals and establishing long-term strategic partnerships with large customers. This role owns advanced, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that often span regions, business units, and decision layers. The ENT AE operates with a high degree of autonomy, shaping deal strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, value-driven solutions.

Your responsibilities as an Account Executive, Enterprise include, but are not limited to the following:

Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership

  • Own and close high-value, complex enterprise opportunities, consistently meeting or exceeding individual quotas.
  • Build a strategic pipeline through self-prospecting, account planning, and SDR partnership.
  • Proactively identify whitespace, expansion potential, and multi-entity opportunities within target accounts.
  • Maintain forecasting, opportunity hygiene, and deal governance in Salesforce (SFDC).

Strategic Discovery & Solution Architecture

  • Lead executive-level discovery to understand enterprise supply chain strategy, risk posture, and long-term business objectives.
  • Navigate complex buying groups across procurement, ops, finance, IT, and senior leadership.
  • Design integrated, multi-product Flexport solutions aligned to customer priorities and business outcomes.
  • Position Flexport as a strategic partner through compelling value narratives, business cases, and solution roadmaps.

Deal Strategy, Negotiation & Closing

  • Own end-to-end deal strategy for complex opportunities, including stakeholder mapping, decision criteria, and close plans.
  • Lead advanced commercial negotiation, pricing, contracts, and non-standard deal structures.
  • Orchestrate internal stakeholders (Ops, Finance, Legal, Product) to progress deals efficiently

Onboarding, Expansion & Relationship Leadership

  • Own the onboarding motion, ensuring enterprise customers are set up for scalable success.
  • Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.
  • Identify expansion opportunities together with Account Management to drive sustained growth.
  • Serve as a point of escalation and strategic advisor during the customer lifecycle.

Enterprise Leadership & Market Impact

  • Act as a senior commercial voice in enterprise pursuits, sharing market insight and customer feedback internally.
  • Contribute to enterprise sales best practices, deal reviews, and peer coaching.
  • Represent Flexport with credibility and confidence in high-stakes customer interactions.

You should have:

  • 5+ years of experience managing complex, enterprise-level sales cycles with consistent quota attainment.
  • Proven ability to close large, multi-stakeholder deals with long sales cycles and high deal complexity.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior decision-makers.
  • Advanced discovery, negotiation, and value-based selling skills.
  • High degree of autonomy, strategic thinking, and commercial judgment.
  • Strong logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain industry experience preferred.

 

What's in there for you: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • Lunches: Claim back up to GBP 15 per day for lunch allowance on office days
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment, in addition to the usual bank holidays in England and Wales.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers employees in UK private medical insurance including a dental care
  • Group Life Insurance 
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Pension plan: Flexport offers employees in the UK a workplace pension plan 
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. You’ll work directly with the Head of Sales, CEO and GTM leadership to shape how Secfix sells into larger customers. You will: Own and drive net-new revenue across mid-market accounts in DACH, with flexibility to close SMB deals when needed Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to close for mid-sized and growing companies Build and maintain pipeline through outbound and inbound opportunities Lead structured discovery and run consultative sales cycles with multiple stakeholders Engage senior decision-makers (CTO, CISO, CIO, Head of IT, COO) Translate complex compliance and security topics into clear business value Collaborate closely with product, legal, onboarding, and domain experts Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts in HubSpot Help define pricing, packaging, qualification, and sales playbooks for mid-market Share market feedback to shape positioning, messaging, and roadmap About You: 3+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS, with a strong focus on mid-market or upmarket deals Competitive and hungry to win deals Proven track record of consistently hitting quota on complex, high-value opportunities Experience managing longer sales cycles and multi-stakeholder decision processes Strong prospecting skills and the drive to source your own pipeline Ability to communicate complex topics clearly in both German and English Comfortable selling to C-level buyers (CISO, CIO, CTO, COO) Familiarity with SaaS sales methodologies (e.g. MEDDICC) is a plus Familiarity with sales tools (HubSpot, Clay, Zapier, Sales Navigator) is a plus Experience in an early-stage startup environment is a plus Nice-to- have: Experience selling into regulated industries (e.g. financial services, healthtech, legaltech) Experience working in an early-stage start-up (Seed - Series B) Academic or extracurricular track record of high achievement (top university, competitive sports, etc.) Strong existing network in the DACH SMB or mid-market tech ecosystem Exposure to compliance, information security, risk, or GRC topics What we offer Hybrid-Flexible Work: 2-3 days in our new sales office in Munich and added flexibility where needed. Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries.We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab. Equity: Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success. Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors. Development Budget: €1,000 annual personal development budget. Home office Budget: Home office budget and access to co-working spaces. Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays. Health Insurance: Comprehensive health coverage. Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (last year we’re headed to Costa Brava!) Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun! description:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik's sales organisation is a unified group of elite cross-functional professionals helping companies across every major industry achieve true resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. As Named Account Executive in Germany, you'll own a portfolio of large enterprise accounts, driving Rubrik's continued expansion in one of Europe's most dynamic enterprise markets.

What You'll Do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts across Germany, combining existing customer relationships with new business development.
  • Run full, multistakeholder sales cycles end to end — from discovery and qualification through solution design, negotiation, and close — across both net-new logo and existing-account expansion deals.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline across your territory, balancing larger strategic opportunities with faster-moving transactional deals.
  • Develop executive relationships within your accounts, translating Rubrik's technical capabilities into the board-level priorities that make data security a strategic imperative.
  • Partner closely with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development, and Rubrik's partner ecosystem to extend reach across your territory and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.
  • Collaborate with and learn from your regional peers — the German team works closely together on deal strategy and account coverage, so you'll grow fastest by leaning on each other.
  • Feed market intelligence back to Rubrik's leadership, including competitive signals and account trends that shape our go-to-market approach across Germany.

Experience You'll Need

  • Experience closing complex enterprise deals, with the appetite to grow into larger, multi-product opportunities — we'll help you build the rest.
  • A track record that shows both new-logo acquisition and growing existing customer relationships.
  • Fluent in German and professional in English; you engage confidently with both technical buyers and executive stakeholders in either language.
  • Understanding of enterprise buying cycles, procurement processes, and multistakeholder decision-making within large or complex organisations.
  • Comfortable working with channel partners and distributors as part of a broader go-to-market motion.

description: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. description: About Rain for Rent International Rain for Rent International provides innovative tank systems for liquid management applications. As an internationally operating rental and service company, expertise centers on rental, logistics, and services around the tank, focusing on the core competencies of renting storage tanks, containment systems, pumps, and filtration units. Your role We are looking for a hands-on Branch Support Manager ( m/f/d ) to help our teams across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France get the best from our business systems, processes and support functions. This is not a traditional IT Manager position. It is a highly business-facing role combining business systems, operational processes, user support, training, continuous improvement and team leadership. You will work closely with our branches and Shared Services teams to understand how people work, where they encounter challenges and how technology and better processes can make their jobs easier and our business more effective. What you will do Become a Business Systems Expert You will develop strong expertise in the applications supporting our European operations and become a trusted point of contact for our business users. A major focus will be our ERP environment, supporting processes such as: Purchasing and purchase orders Goods and invoice receipt Rental contracts Equipment on-hire and off-hire Recurring and final billing Credit notes and ad-hoc invoicing Customer, supplier and item master data You will also support the effective use of CRM, Microsoft 365 and other operational applications. Experience with inspHire, Zoho or Twinfield would be advantageous, but previous knowledge of our specific applications is not essential if you have strong ERP/business systems experience and learn quickly. Help People Get the Best From Technology You will work directly with colleagues across our branches to understand challenges, answer questions and identify better ways of working. That includes: Providing practical systems and process support Training new and existing users Developing SOPs, quick-reference guides and training materials Creating screen recordings and short training videos Building a structured, version-controlled knowledge library Identifying recurring problems and addressing their root causes Most importantly, you will explain the why, not only the how. Connect Systems With Business Reality Good systems only create good information when they are used correctly. You will therefore work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, Fleet and other Shared Services functions to improve the quality and consistency of the processes behind our data. You will help us ensure that operational information, CRM pipelines, rental transactions, margins and management KPIs accurately reflect what is happening in the business. Listen, Challenge and Improve Our branches know their business and will bring you ideas and requirements. Your job is not simply to say yes. You will listen, understand the underlying need and assess whether the best answer is a change to a system, process, training or something else. For larger initiatives, you will help structure requirements, assess benefits, costs, effort and risks, and make clear recommendations to leadership. Lead a Small Team You will lead a developing Branch Support function, expected to include approximately three team members across business support and IT/helpdesk activities. This remains a hands-on role. You will lead the team while actively participating in support, training, problem solving and improvement initiatives yourself. Stay Curious Technology is changing quickly and we want to take advantage of it. You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about tools such as Microsoft Copilot, automation and new ways technology can help colleagues work more effectively. The Person We Are Looking For Systems knowledge matters, but how you work with people matters just as much. You are someone who: Listens before proposing a solution Is patient and enjoys explaining things Can train and support colleagues with different levels of systems experience Builds credibility and strong working relationships Can persuade and influence without relying on hierarchy Is comfortable constructively challenging a request Is pragmatic and realistic about priorities, resources and costs Learns new business processes quickly Enjoys solving problems Is comfortable being visible and close to the operational business Is curious about technology and AI You should be equally comfortable discussing a process with a branch administrator, working through a systems problem with IT, understanding a commercial requirement from Sales or presenting a recommendation to leadership. European Scope The role supports operations across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France. Regular interaction with the branches is a fundamental part of the position. You should therefore be willing to travel across our European locations, build strong relationships with local teams and spend time understanding how our operations work in practice. Regular office presence is also expected, currently anticipated at up to three days per week at our office in Potsdam. Why This Role? This is an opportunity to shape a developing European support function rather than simply inherit an established helpdesk. You will have the opportunity to influence: How we use our business systems How we support and train users How processes are standardised across countries How knowledge is documented and shared How new technology and AI are adopted How Branch Support develops as our European organisation evolves If you enjoy bringing together people, processes and technology and want a role where you can see the practical impact of your work across the business, we would like to hear from you. Rain for Rent International is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. description:
Mission

De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.

Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.

Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.
  • Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.
  • Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.
  • Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.
  • Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.
  • Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.
  • Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.

 

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.
  2. Votre code est testé et maintenable.
  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.
  4. La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.
  5. Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.
  6. Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.
  • Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.
  • Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.
  • Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.
  • Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

 

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

 

Rémunération : 75 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité + jusqu’à 8 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil international spécialisé en Data et Intelligence Artificielle, présent dans plus de 20 pays avec plus de 2 500 collaborateurs.

Nos équipes réunissent notamment des Business Consultants, Data Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers, qui interviennent auprès de grands groupes internationaux dans des secteurs variés.

Ton rôle

  • Garantir la bonne application du processus et des méthodes d’évaluation
  • Veiller à une expérience de recrutement de qualité pour les candidatures et les équipes internes

description: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the role As we grow, we’re looking to expand our Complaints handling team. As an excellent communicator, you will quickly build relationships with customers and other departments across Lendable to understand customer friction points and come to fair and objective decisions. If you have experience of either handling complex complaints (preferably motor or secured product related) or have worked in the automotive finance sector and have the following skills we’d love to hear from you: Problem solving and decision making skills - putting the customer at the heart of everything you do The ability to assess and critique evidence coming to a fair and comprehensive decision Be able to shift focus and re-prioritise workloads based on business and customer needs Great phone and written communication skills, being clear and concise to promote customer understanding. The ability to build rapport and manage multiple third parties including ensuring that customer expectations are managed. Also, even better if you have: Experience of working in a regulated motor finance environment An understanding of the Consumer Rights Act 2015 An understanding of Motor related policies and industry standards The ability to comprehend complex Satisfactory Quality-related complaints Strong experience working with the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS). Your team’s objectives Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. Lendable is committed to providing excellent customer service and ensuring that it reaches the right outcomes for our customers. Feedback is an important part of how we can evolve as a business to ensure that we are meeting our customers' expectations and continuously improving our service and the team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insights to the business in order to improve and grow. Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers, and therefore to the benefit of us as a business, has never been more important than now; as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets. How you’ll impact those objectives The ideal candidate will have experience of resolving complaints or customer disputes within a regulated environment and have an aptitude for investigating, analysing, problem-solving and dispute resolution. You will be able to self manage a varied and complex caseload, identifying best contact mechanisms for customers and prioritising cases where appropriate to be highly productive and efficient, and to maintain the required level of performance against our KPI minimum standards. You will champion using our AI tools and technology to bring a first class service to our customers. You will work well under pressure and be adaptable, being able to turn your hand to other areas of operational need, as the business may require. You will ensure that you follow our complaint handling standards, have good record keeping skills and ensure that all decisions made are backed up with demonstrable evidence and rationale. You will work closely with the Complaints Team, to resolve complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, as well as be responsible for feeding back to both frontline and product teams on product and process improvements across the Operations Team and wider Lendable business. You will be responsible for communicating with the complainant, either in writing or by phone and will enjoy finding solutions to issues raised, managing customer expectations and handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism. You will have a good knowledge and understanding of FCA regulation as well as DISP complaint handling rules and guidance. You will also ensure that you maintain up to date knowledge of Lendable’s products through effective use and review of policies, procedures and business tools made available to you. You will have strong letter writing skills, being able to create professional final response letters which break down complex issues into comprehensible information for consumers to understand. You will also have a sound moral compass, speaking up where necessary to ensure that good customer outcomes are always at the heart of what we do, striving to resolve complaints without the need for the customer to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service, and ensuring you are applying any learnings from both internal and FOS complaints to future complaint cases. The Interview Process A quick phone call with one of the team An exercise to demonstrate your ability to resolve complaints An assessment to evidence your knowledge of FCA regulations and DISP complaint handling rules/guidance. Onsite Interview Discuss the exercises you have completed Meet the team you’ll work with daily Life at Lendable Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the role The Front-Line Operations Agent plays a vital customer-facing role, responsible for delivering high-quality support for a designated Lendable product, encompassing both general customer service and financial support. You will follow established processes to resolve a variety of complex customer queries, ensuring interactions are efficient, accurate, and empathetic—applying your cross-functional expertise across general service needs and more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys. This role is key in ensuring our service continually evolves to better meet the needs of all customers. You’ll be based in our Chatham office, joining the team on-site three days a week. You’ll work two weekends a month, but to keep your work-life balance in check, you’ll get a day in lieu the week before to ensure you never work more than five days a week. Key Responsibilities Deliver exceptional support for a designated Lendable product, expertly handling a full spectrum of customer service and financial support queries via multiple channels, efficiently executing established processes. Listen actively and provide clear, accurate responses, adapting communication style to each customer's needs, including those in vulnerable situations or with complex financial queries including customers in financial difficulty to ensure appropriate support solutions are implemented. Take end-to-end ownership of customer interactions, ensuring every query is managed through to effective resolution or appropriate escalation. Build rapport and trust while maintaining control of conversations, ensuring positive and compliant customer outcomes. Ask effective probing questions to understand a customer’s financial circumstances and identify appropriate support options. Work flexibly within your designated product area, adapting fluidly between general customer service and financial support requirements, and responding to varying service needs and complex customer queries. Operational Excellence & Process Execution Meet and exceed targets and KPIs related to customer satisfaction, quality, and compliance by consistently following key operational procedures and applying appropriate judgement to specific customer circumstances. Effectively use AI and digital tools to streamline customer interactions and deliver faster, more accurate service. Identify blockers, process gaps, or recurring issues and communicate these to relevant teams, supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Log all interactions accurately and ensure data integrity for audit and learning purposes. Continuous Improvement & Feedback Provide clear, actionable feedback from frontline experiences to enhance our knowledge base, training resources, and AI systems. Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to enhance the customer journey, automation, and operational efficiency. Remain up to date with ongoing system, product, and process changes, readily adapting to evolving procedures. Learning & Development Respond positively to coaching and feedback, using it to improve performance and customer outcomes. Demonstrate initiative in learning new tools, products, and procedures as they are introduced. Share knowledge and support colleagues, helping to create a culture of collaborative learning. Experience & Skills Previous experience in a contact centre environment, with demonstrated experience in both customer service and financial support roles (or a combined equivalent), particularly within financial services. Demonstrated ability to handle complex queries with empathy, accuracy, and ownership. Confident in following structured processes and able to identify opportunities to improve them. Strong communication, rapport-building, and conflict resolution skills. Skilled in using digital tools and comfortable adopting new technologies, including AI-driven platforms. Organised and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting. Proactive in offering feedback and participating in process and AI improvement initiatives. Behaviours & Approach Customer-focused, with a passion for delivering consistent, positive outcomes. Resilient, adaptable, and open to constant change and learning. Collaborative, supportive team player committed to shared success. High level of accountability and personal ownership for customer outcomes and process execution. Constructive, solutions-focused approach with willingness to challenge the status quo. Perks & Benefits More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years. Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success. Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one. Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs. Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards! Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business. Our Interview Process We want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us! Here is what you can expect: Step 1: Talent Screening Call and Mock CRM/Email Exercise A quick chat with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to talk through your experience, what you are looking for, and answers to any initial questions you have. You will also complete a quick task where you will be navigating through a mock - CRM system and replying to some email enquiries Step 2: Onsite Interview & Role Preview A 1-hour interview at our Chatham office. To give you a true feel for our environment, you will also have the optional chance to jump on a live call-listening session to experience the role firsthand! Life at Lendable Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. description: Warum wir tun, was wir tun Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time. Warum es diese Rolle braucht Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. description: About the role As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week. You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business. Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence. Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge. Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question. Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake. Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us. Requirements What You’ll Need Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field. 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's. Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously. Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does. Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams. Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope. Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there. ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

ABOUT RM SOTHEBY’S

RM Sotheby’s is the world's leading collector car auction house, specializing in the sale of the world's most exceptional automobiles. With a global presence and a reputation built on expertise, integrity, and unparalleled client service, RM Sotheby’s has established itself as a trusted leader in the international collector car market.

Beyond its renowned live auctions, RM Sotheby’s offers clients exclusive opportunities to buy and sell through RM Sotheby’s Sealed, an innovative and discreet auction platform, and Private Sales, providing a personalized, confidential approach to buying and selling extraordinary automobiles through private treaty transactions.

Our global team of specialists and professionals works closely with collectors, enthusiasts, and industry leaders to deliver extraordinary experiences and results. We offer a dynamic, collaborative environment where individuals have the opportunity to build meaningful careers in the exciting world of collector automobiles.

THE ROLE

The Director of Sales, Switzerland will lead and grow RM Sotheby's business in Switzerland and the neighbouring DACH markets, across both Auctions and Private Sales. Reporting to the Managing Director, they will build deep, trusted networks among Swiss collectors, family offices, private banks and wealth managers, and lead client adoption of Sealed in Switzerland. They will work on the development of the Swiss team, collaborate with other Sotheby’s categories and the wider European team to give clients a seamless service across the region. They will also work on our Swiss auctions, supporting consignments, client development and sale delivery for RM Sotheby's auctions in Switzerland alongside Private Sales and Sealed. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build lasting and trusted relationships with clients based on collector car expertise and quality advice.
  • Work with the Managing Director and leadership team to lead and grow revenue and infrastructure in Switzerland and the neighbouring DACH markets.
  • Build and maintain strong networks with Swiss collectors, family offices, private banks, wealth managers and their advisers.
  • Work with the Managing Director to lead the client adoption and expansion of the Sealed business in Switzerland.
  • Work closely with Sotheby's luxury division in Switzerland to identify opportunities for collaboration and client development.
  • Drive revenues through consignments for private sales, Sealed and brokerage, including identifying collector cars for inventory for future sale and the sale of collector cars in inventory.
  • Help clients fulfil their passion, build/divest their collection, or make financial/portfolio decisions.
  • Drive revenues by providing appraisals for estate planning, financing and other client needs.
  • Promote existing private sale consignments, sales, and events to current or prospective clients.
  • Be a brand ambassador and represent RM Sotheby's at events in Switzerland, across Europe and at key international events.
  • Also work on our Swiss auctions alongside Private Sales and Sealed, supporting consignments, client development and sale delivery for RM Sotheby's auctions in Switzerland.
  • Work on the development of the Swiss team, and support, train and mentor junior team members, where relevant.
  • Generate and develop new clients by networking and following up on assigned leads.
  • Work with RMS research department and communicate history, provenance, and unique selling features of private sales consignments.
  • Other activities related to generating revenues via transaction of motor cars as assigned by Employer.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES

  • Significant senior experience in collector car sales, auctions or dealing, or in private banking, wealth management or luxury sales with a strong collector car focus.
  • An established network among Swiss and European collectors, family offices, private banks and wealth managers.
  • Proven ability to originate and close high-value transactions, and to develop and mentor colleagues.
  • Fluent English, plus fluent German and/or French; Italian is a plus.
  • Right to work in Switzerland.
  • Impeccable discretion and confidentiality in dealing with UHNW clients.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across Switzerland and Europe, and to key international events.

description:
About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

What You’ll Do

1. Position Summary

Our experience operators and suppliers are the product. Every traveler experience on Viator starts with an operator who is seamlessly onboarded, verified, and supported; every Bókun customer decides whether to stay in their first weeks on the platform, and requires ongoing technical support for success and retention.

As Director, Service Delivery & Excellence, B2B, you will lead the end-to-end B2B support organization across Viator Supply and Bókun. Combining Front-Line Service Delivery and Service Excellence into a single mandate, you will modernize support operations—leveraging AI and automation to reduce cost-to-serve while elevating quality, first-contact resolution, and supplier satisfaction across the complete partner lifecycle.

Location: UK (Hybrid - Commutable to Oxford 2-3 days per week)

2. Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy and Planning: Responsible for the development and execution of the B2B support organization in line with Company strategy and OKRs.

  • End-to-End B2B Support Operations: Own front-line operational delivery across Viator Supply (onboarding, product creation/setup, compliance, verification, ongoing support) and Bókun (sign-up support, early customer success, SaaS technical support).

  • BPO Strategy & Vendor Governance: Lead end-to-end BPO commercial relationships across partner sites in North Africa and Asia—managing RFPs, contract negotiations, SOWs, workforce capacity planning, and vendor performance management.

  • AI & Operational Transformation: Identify, design, and ship AI-driven tooling, self-serve capabilities, and workflow automation across in-house and outsourced operations to scale support efficiently.

  • Compliance, Verification & Quality Control: Enforce strict onboarding workflows (business verification, liability insurance, legal compliance) and audit supplier quality metrics to protect platform integrity and traveler experience.

  • Process Excellence & Systems Ownership: Apply continuous improvement frameworks (Lean Six Sigma) to eliminate friction; own the support technology stack with Salesforce at the core.

  • Commercial Contribution & Budgeting: Manage operational headcount, vendor spend, and tooling budgets. Expand proactive quality initiatives and revenue-generating support activities (supplier upsells and SaaS tier upgrades).

  • Collaborate effectively with Key Stakeholders: within the Supply/Bokun organizations and across the organization

3. Requirements & Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years in B2B support, partner operations, or service delivery, including proven leadership experience managing managers.

  • Scale & BPO Management: Proven success leading multi-site operations (100+ FTE) with hands-on BPO vendor management (RFPs, contract negotiations, QA, and governance).

  • AI & Automation Track Record: Demonstrated experience deploying AI or automation tools across support, vetting, or operational workflows with measurable impact.

  • Salesforce & Technology Systems: Strong working knowledge of Salesforce as a support platform (Salesforce Administrator training preferred) alongside contact-center telephony and knowledge systems.

  • Compliance & Workforce Planning: Experience operating in regulated environments with compliance/vetting frameworks; expertise in workforce forecasting and capacity planning across hybrid teams.

  • Budget Stewardship & Travel: Full operational budget ownership (staffing, vendor spend, tooling); willing to travel internationally c. 30% of the time (site visits to North Africa and Asia).

  • Preferred: Travel, hospitality, or SaaS/marketplace industry experience; COPC certification; Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.

4. Leadership Values & Attributes

  • Traveler First: Recognize that supplier operational health directly shapes traveler experience. Practice Behavioral Truth Seeking (prioritizing customer action over anecdotes) and Scientific Validation (utilizing A/B testing over expert opinion).

  • Execution is Our Edge: Drive High-Velocity Execution using the 80/20 rule. Champion AI-First Adoption to automate manual tasks and maintain a fail-fast learning mindset.

  • We Succeed Together: Practice Radical Accountability ("no problem is someone else's problem") and Empowered Ownership by pushing decisions to the lowest level. Lead with high EQ, low ego, and empathetic change leadership.

 

What We Offer 

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

 

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

description:
The Rubrik Engineering team is comprised of people who produce extraordinary results. Our engineers are driven to build efficient, reliable, and cost-effective products. We believe in empowering our teams, giving engineers autonomy and responsibility, not just tasks. Our goal is to motivate and challenge you to do the best work of your career. As part of the Rubrik Engineering team, you will work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define the next generation of products for Rubrik. At Rubrik, nothing will stop you from thinking big. We are looking for individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the prospect of a challenge. If you have a positive attitude, high energy and limitless drive, and like to win, we want to talk to you.

Job Overview

The Platform Solutions Architect is a key sales specialist who brings deep technical expertise to the broader sales organisation. You will work with customers & prospects to educate how Rubrik protects and manages data across the enterprise estate, from virtualisation, physical servers, NAS, and databases to cloud, SaaS, and identity. You will own the technical side of the sale from first conversation to validated decision. That includes running proof of concept, producing technical documentation, diagrams and guiding complex, multi-stakeholder discussions. You will also bring field insight back to Product and Engineering, test features before release, and help enable the wider sales team. Your technical credibility and influence with customers will drive results now and shape the product over time.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead technical conversations, in person and remote, with audiences from practitioners to executives.
  • Working closely with account teams to run in-depth discovery to connect technical capabilities to customer pain, risk, and business outcomes.
  • Guide complex engagements that involve several teams and competing priorities, such as infrastructure, applications, database, cloud, security, identity, and compliance. Build consensus among them and handle objections and competitive pressure.
  • Own the technical win. Agree POC scope and success criteria with the customer, plan and deliver the POC, resolve blockers, and present results that support the business case.
  • Assist with technical implementation and validation of the product.
  • Design resilient backup, recovery, and cyber resilience architectures across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Workloads include:
  • Hypervisors and virtualized infrastructure (VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix AHV). Physical servers (Windows, Linux). NAS and unstructured data. Enterprise databases (Oracle, SQL Server, and others). Public cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).
  • Advise on identity resilience and integration with identity providers (Entra, AD, Okta, Ping).
  • Advocate for automation through Infrastructure as Code and APIs.
  • Sales and field enablement
  • Work closely with sales teams from initial discovery through technical validation, contributing to deal strategy and competitive positioning.
  • Create and deliver presentations that enable systems engineers, and act as a technical resource for opportunities.
  • Work with Product Management and Engineering to find and address product gaps, bringing real-world insight from POCs and customer deployments.
  • Remote position with approximately 50% travel for onsite meetings, as required.
  • Attend internal meetings and events, in person and remote, as required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise data protection, infrastructure, or a closely related focus area.
  • Hands-on experience with backup, high availability, and disaster recovery for enterprise workloads such as virtualization, physical servers, NAS, and databases.
  • Experience delivering customer POCs or technical validations in complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience influencing senior technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including identity, networking, and security fundamentals. Knowledge of identity providers (Entra, AD, Okta) is also valued.
  • Scripting experience in a relevant language (Python, PowerShell, Bash, etc.). Terraform or similar IaC experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience giving technical presentations to small and large audiences.
  • Ability to manage your own time and projects. 

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com

Inclusion @ Rubrik

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:

  • Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.

  • Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.

  • Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Wellpass membership

description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. Implementation Managers work with our customers, from small Biotech startups to the largest BioPharmas in the world to develop a deep understanding of their R&D Processes, and roll out solutions that transform how their research teams work together. To be successful in this role, you will leverage your scientific background, project management skills, and product expertise to drive successful implementations of the Benchling platform. You will work hand in hand with the research scientists at our customers, and teams throughout Benchling to implement our solutions, and ensure our customers are successful. Implementation Managers lead all aspects of customer rollouts from requirements analysis and solution design, to configurations, testing, training, and onboarding users onto the system. Fluent or native French or German, plus experience supporting French- or German-speaking customers. RESPONSIBILITIES Manage initial rollouts for new Benchling customers as well as expansion projects with new teams or for new processes at existing customers Own implementation success from project kickoff to go-live, leveraging strong project management skills, scientific expertise, and deep product knowledge. Build and execute detailed project plans, own project activities, work with other team members to execute on project deliverables to ensure on time, on budget, high quality deployments. Understand customers' scientific workflows and determine how Benchling can best be leveraged to meet their key business needs. description: Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie. Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration. Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques. Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés. Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage. À ce titre, vous : Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration. Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration. Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats. description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted’s Revenue domain is growing — Ads business is on the mission to develop an advertising ecosystem within Vinted and we’re just getting started. We’re looking for a Lead Data Scientist to join our cross-functional team in Ads to help us make the most of our real estate and evolve toward a high‑performance, privacy‑respectful, in‑house advertising ecosystem over time. Think: an ad of an external partner can generate euros directly but we may well advertise our own Marketplace services or newly launched categories to optimise on net revenue as well as user engagement. 

If you have built performance-first Ad optimisation systems and are ready to take on hands-on work while shaping the Data Science roadmaps from a greenfield state - this role is for you.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Own optimization logic for Ads systems. Own the data science approach behind core Ads optimization problems such as ranking, targeting, pacing, budget allocation, candidate selection, and auction or bidding logic where relevant.
  • Develop practical approaches that improve advertiser performance, marketplace relevance, and business outcomes.
  • Take charge of model and algorithm development. Design, develop, and iterate models and algorithmic approaches used in Ads delivery and optimization. This may include prediction, scoring, calibration, exploration/exploitation methods, and constrained optimization approaches suited to Vinted’s marketplace context.
  • Lead experimentation and performance improvement frameworks. Own the analytical and experimental process for improving optimization systems. Define hypotheses, evaluation frameworks or logic changes and support translating learnings into better system behavior.
  • Guide objective function and constraint design. Help define optimization objectives that balance advertiser value, revenue, user experience, and operational constraints. Turn product and business goals into tractable optimization problems and implementable Data Science logic.
  • Be responsible for Ads performance diagnostics. Own deep-dive analysis of system behavior and performance degradation. Identify where delivery, relevance, auction dynamics, supply-demand imbalance, or model issues are limiting outcomes, and propose solutions.
  • Contribute to Production implementation in Ads. Partner with engineering and Decision Scientists to move models and optimization logic from idea to reliable implementation.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Decision Scientists, Analytics Engineers and developers to shape advertiser-facing features and internal optimization capabilities with a clear understanding of feasibility, impact, and tradeoffs from the Data Science perspective.
  • Collaborate with Decision Science counterparts and other Data Scientists to ensure optimization changes are evaluated with appropriate metrics, guardrails, and marketplace context.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, and backend teams to ensure training data, feedback loops, online signals, and offline datasets are suitable for robust optimization work.
  • Help explain system behavior, performance drivers, and expected impacts of optimization changes to non-technical stakeholders when needed.

About you 

We are looking for someone who combines:

  • strong applied machine learning and statistical skills,
  • experience with Ad Tech systems and optimization problems,
  • strong product and business judgment,
  • comfort working on production systems with engineers,
  • and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, evolving domains.

The strongest candidates will have experience in areas such as:

  • ads ranking,
  • auction systems,
  • pacing and budget optimization,
  • marketplace or recommendation systems,
  • relevance modeling,
  • or other real-time optimization environments where multiple objectives must be balanced.
  • Well-versed in Python and SQL, BigQuery is an advantage
  • Have a structured, meticulous way of working when trying out different approaches towards a set goal
  • Be a conscious team player who understands when their work touches that of other team members and proactively aligns with them
  • Good at explaining details of machine learning methods to lay audiences
  • Solid written and spoken English

  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
